keyFindings.description: storedActors (726-746) guesses one actor or a list from the first byte, and turns a malformed actor column, or an element with no kind or id, into [] ('nobody recorded') with no error. Every caller knows its column's shape (single actor: issues.created_by, events.actor, artifacts.created_by, asks.author, comments.author, messages.author, ask.edited payload edited_by; list: artifact_versions.authors), all jsonb not null and written from model.Actor, and refs/refs.go:388-393 decodes the same artifacts.created_by and artifact_versions.authors strictly and returns the error. Decode each column as its shape (for example jsonb_build_array on the single-actor columns in SQL, then json.Unmarshal into []model.Actor), keep SQL NULL from a left join as [], and return a decode error as refs.go does.

No '## Contract change census' in the PR body. The driver now refuses to start without COMPONENT_SOURCE (line 40) and, for fixture, FAKE_GITHUB_PORT; its callers include the INFRA-156 tree plan's invocations (dispatch://INFRA-156/artifact/plan-md, Task 2.9 and the coordinator's production run, with DISPATCH_URL/DISPATCH_TOKEN/PROJECT only) and the sibling slices that extend the driver. contracts GraphNode.changed_at widened from string to string | null. The census lists the search commands, every hit with a disposition, and a rollout line (warn-first, or an immediate refusal with its reason).

'components that existed before this release answer null until they change' is wrong for made_at: 0131 seeds made_at null and the importer upsert (architecture/importer.go:583-588) never sets made_at on an existing row, so it stays null permanently; only changed_at is filled by a later change.
Cleanup, no behaviour change: RemovedBlockFacts (349) fills four fields of a node api/references.go:141-154 built, through a pointer parameter; return the facts (or the whole node) instead.

Cleanup, no behaviour change: the comment parent order (reply, then ask thread, then document) is written both in the SQL join condition (575) and the Go switch (596-605); drop 'c.reply_to is null and c.ask_id is null' from the join and leave the order to the switch.
